summary: FedEx filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting the consummation of two investment-grade bond offerings that closed the same day. Under a September 9 underwriting agreement with Citigroup, BofA, Wells Fargo, BNP Paribas, ING and Scotiabank, the company issued €1.1bn of 4.000% notes due 2030, €900m of 4.625% notes due 2034, and $1.1bn of 5.750% notes due 2036. This is a routine shelf takedown registered on Form S-3, not a special situation; proceeds likely fund general corporate purposes.
